title: 第164章 炼尸术四目 最少三天九叔 我赌一天半第163章 阴神出游融灵观想法的神奇效果
slug: 九叔饲养百倍返还僵尸成旱魃
content_zh:
;;
这一番修炼下来。
虽然修为依旧停留在法师后期，可真正的战力，却比进入山海灵虚界前强了数成不止。
若是再遇上寻常大法师境后期修士，应付起来只会更加轻松。
还有就是这一轮返还出来的资源，基本都已经物尽其用。
其中地龙血池还在缓慢凝聚龙气血液，暂时无法使用。
炼制血元丹所需的辅材，也只差最后几味核心主药。
只是那些药材能否在近期找到，还要看机缘和运气。
“接下来最重要的事情，便是将厉长生的尸体彻底炼成僵尸了。”
苏辰目光微闪，暗自盘算。
只要炼制成功，便能对厉长生进行饲养。
厉长生生前可是实打实的人师圆满境高手，尸身根底比黑魔法都强上一线。
以厉长生的品质，一旦触发高倍返还，得到的东西绝不会比黑魔法师差，甚至可能更好。
想到这里，苏辰心念一动，眼前景象如水波般变化起来。
等他再次看清周围时，已经回到了房间里。
苏辰看向了窗外，现在天色已然大亮。
此时义庄前院中，也隐隐传来秋生和文才的抱怨声。
苏辰伸了个懒腰，起身活动了一下筋骨。
一阵细密的脆响随之传出，浑身上下都充满了力量。
“这个时辰，师父和四目师叔应该已经起来喝早茶了。”

苏辰推开房门，嘴里继续自语。
“正好趁这个机会，去找师叔学一学炼尸养尸之术。”
越早掌握这门手艺，便能越早炼制厉长生的尸身，开启下一轮饲养。
苏辰迈步向正堂方向走去。
还没靠近，便远远看到院中老槐树下摆着两张藤编躺椅。
九叔和四目各自躺在一张椅子上。
两人一边悠闲地品着热茶，一边有一搭没一搭地看着书，显得十分自在。
然而，院墙角落里，却是另一番景象。
秋生和文才正满脸痛苦地扎着马步，双腿抖得像筛糠一样。
二人头顶和双臂上，分别放着一只斟满茶水的瓷杯，稍有不慎，茶水便会洒出来。
最要命的是，他们胯下还立着一炉手指粗的高香。
香头火星明灭，距离二人的裤裆不过数寸。
只要腿脚一软，稍微往下蹲上一点，便能感受到一股直钻天灵盖的灼热。
文才双腿不断颤抖，额头上的汗珠顺着脸颊往下流。
秋生同样没好到哪里去，嘴唇都快被咬白了，显然也在苦苦支撑。
听到院外传来的脚步声，两人艰难地抬起头。
当看到苏辰走进院子时，眼中顿时露出强烈的求助之色，仿佛看到了救星。

After practicing this.
Although his cultivation is still in the late stage of the mage, his real combat power is much stronger than before entering the mountain and sea spiritual realm.
If you encounter an ordinary late-stage Archmage monk again, it will only be easier to deal with it.
Also, the resources returned in this round have basically been fully utilized.
Among them, the Earth Dragon Blood Pool is still slowly condensing dragon energy and blood, and is temporarily unavailable.
The auxiliary materials needed to refine the Blood Essence Pill are only short of the last few core ingredients.
But whether those medicinal materials can be found in the near future depends on chance and luck.
"The most important thing next is to completely transform Li Changsheng's corpse into a zombie."
Su Chen's eyes flashed slightly, making secret calculations.
As long as the refining is successful, Li Changsheng can be raised.
Li Changsheng was a real Master of Human Master Perfection Realm before his death, and his body was basically better than black magic.
With Li Changsheng's quality, once the high-multiply return is triggered, what he gets will never be worse than the black magician, and may even be better.
Thinking of this, Su Chen thought, and the scene in front of him changed like water waves.
When he looked around again, he was already back in the room.
Su Chen looked out the window, it was already bright.
At this time, Qiu Sheng and Wen Cai's complaints could also be heard faintly in the front yard of Yizhuang.
Su Chen stretched and stood up to stretch his muscles.
A thin crunching sound followed, and his whole body was filled with power.
"At this time, Master and Uncle Four Eyes should have already gotten up to have morning tea."
Su Chen pushed open the door and continued talking to himself.
"Just take this opportunity to go to your uncle to learn the art of refining and raising corpses."
The sooner you master this skill, the sooner you can refine Li Changsheng's body and start the next round of breeding.
Su Chen walked toward the main hall.
Before I got close, I saw two rattan deck chairs placed under the old locust tree in the courtyard.
Uncle Jiu and Simu each lay on a chair.
The two of them were leisurely sipping hot tea and reading books, looking very comfortable.
However, in the corner of the courtyard wall, there was a different scene.
Qiu Sheng and Wen Cai were gaiting with pain on their faces, their legs shaking like chaff.
On their heads and arms, there were porcelain cups filled with tea. If they were not careful, the tea would spill out.
The most terrible thing is that there is a furnace of incense as thick as a finger standing under their crotch.
The sparks on the head of the incense flickered, only a few inches away from their crotches.
As long as your legs and feet soften and you squat down a little, you can feel the burning heat that goes straight through the Tianling Cap.
Wencai's legs kept shaking, and the sweat on his forehead flowed down his cheeks.
Qiu Sheng was not much better either. His lips were bitten almost white, and he was obviously struggling to hold on.
Hearing the footsteps coming from outside the courtyard, the two of them raised their heads with difficulty.
When he saw Su Chen walking into the yard, his eyes suddenly showed a strong look for help, as if he had seen a savior.
